threeChecks.title: Three things I check first in any account
threeChecks.description: Before touching bids or budget, these three leaks usually cost 20–40% of ad spend.

items.title: Search terms that waste spend
items.detail: Broad match keywords and loose phrase matching trigger irrelevant, low-intent queries. I scour the search terms report and build rigorous negative keyword lists to stop wasted burn immediately.

items.title: Conversion tracking that isn't firing properly
items.detail: Double-counting page views as leads, unverified purchase tags, or broken CRM webhooks ruin smart bidding models. I verify pixel firing, offline conversion sync, and deduplication before scaling.

items.title: Budget spread across weak campaigns
items.detail: Spreading ₹1,00,000 across 12 campaigns dilutes algorithm learning. I concentrate 80% of budget into proven, high-converting campaigns while keeping 20% strictly isolated for disciplined A/B testing.
